question: For the 2011/2012 season, identify leagues where the average height of home players exceeds the overall average height across all leagues in that season. List the top 3 such leagues by total goals scored (home and away combined) in ascending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH home_players AS (
  SELECT m.XCL_008 AS league_id, p.XCL_126 AS height
  FROM Match m
  JOIN Player p ON m.XCL_061 = p.XCL_122
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2011/2012'
),
league_avg AS (
  SELECT league_id, AVG(height) AS avg_h
  FROM home_players
  GROUP BY league_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(height) AS overall_h FROM home_players
),
goals AS (
  SELECT m.XCL_008 AS league_id, SUM(m.XCL_015 + m.XCL_016) AS total_goals
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2011/2012'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_008
)
SELECT l.XCL_005
FROM league_avg la
JOIN overall o ON 1=1
JOIN goals g ON la.league_id = g.league_id
JOIN League l ON l.XCL_003 = la.league_id
WHERE la.avg_h > o.overall_h
ORDER BY g.total_goals ASC
LIMIT 3

        m.XCL_013 AS home_team_id,

        m.XCL_010 AS home_goals,
        m.XCL_011 AS away_goals,
        m.XCL_061 AS home_player_1,

        m.XCL_063 AS home_player_3,
        m.XCL_064 AS home_player_4,
        m.XCL_065 AS home_player_5,

        m.XCL_067 AS home_player_7,
        m.XCL_068 AS home_player_8,
        m.XCL_069 AS home_player_9,
        m.XCL_070 AS home_player_10,
        m.XCL_071 AS home_player_11
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.XCL_009 LIKE '%2011%' OR m.XCL_009 LIKE '%2012%'
),
HomePlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_1 = p.XCL_122
    UNION

    UNION

    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_4 = p.XCL_122
    UNION

        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_5 = p.XCL_122
    UNION
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_6 = p.XCL_122
    UNION
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_7 = p.XCL_122
    UNION
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_8 = p.XCL_122
    UNION
    SELECT

        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_9 = p.XCL_122
    UNION
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_10 = p.XCL_122
    UNION
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    JOIN Player p ON sm.home_player_11 = p.XCL_122
),
PlayerHeights AS (
    SELECT 
        hp.league_id,
        pa.XCL_132 AS height
    FROM HomePlayers hp
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON hp.player_id = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE pa.XCL_132 IS NOT NULL
),
LeagueAvgHeight AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        AVG(height) AS avg_height
    FROM PlayerHeights
    GROUP BY league_id
),
OverallAvgHeight AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(height) AS overall_avg_height
    FROM PlayerHeights
),
LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.league_id,
        SUM(sm.home_goals + sm.away_goals) AS total_goals
    FROM SeasonMatches sm
    GROUP BY sm.league_id
)
SELECT 
    l.XCL_005 AS league_name
FROM LeagueAvgHeight lah
JOIN OverallAvgHeight oah ON lah.avg_height > oah.overall_avg_height
JOIN LeagueGoals lg ON lah.league_id = lg.league_id
JOIN League l ON lah.league_id = l.XCL_003
ORDER BY lg.total_goals ASC
LIMIT 3
